answer: No. Keep anvil_validate_write. docs/guides/ai-context-delivery.md — Graph context is not launch validation — splits the MCP surface: launch validation (anvil_validate_write) is the enforcement gate with allow/warn/gateUnavailable/block vocabulary; graph context is read-only projection that returns context, never a decision, and never blocks. A fluent Decision Brief that says an edit is safe is advisory only. plans/modules/context-compiler.aps.md and the draft Context Compiler spec state the same trust boundary: a Decision Brief is never allow / warn / block and is never a substitute for anvil_validate_write or the deterministic policy/check engine. Enforcement must keep working if Context Compiler is unavailable, stale, or wrong. Correct first action: keep anvil_validate_write; do not use the brief as a write permit.
